scope: Native NRT browser, APAC test wallets, staging only. Fresh registration followed immediately by three verified signatures. No blockchain broadcast.
budget: Existing $25 Cloudflare budget. No new infrastructure or keepalive.

design.sdkLimitation: Frozen SDK predates 30efde86 fresh session reconciliation through prepare. All arms use that same SDK. Current source already removes its separate material-authorization status request.
limits: Small sequential cohorts; no guaranteed speedup or latency ceiling.
Request summaries include background refill during registration and signing. They are not counts per signature or per initial presignature.
Following signatures can wait for material. They are not a ready-material benchmark.
Nested stage medians cannot be added or subtracted to derive unmeasured spans.

excludedRun.name: rollback-placement-retained
excludedRun.reason: Version rollback retained targeted placement at HKG. Excluded from control comparison. Then redeployed latest version, explicitly restored Tokyo placement, and rolled back the original version again.

historicalConfirmationEvidence.scope: Earlier combined-prepare ready cohort; separate from this placement comparison.
historicalConfirmationEvidence.interpretation: SDK time before commit includes confirmation. Automation polls at 250ms by default. Its observation clock cannot be subtracted from SDK stage clocks to assign all residual time.

validation.protocolSchedulingIntegration: passed; exact transcripts preserved for 8, 7 and 6 request schedules

reproduction.requirements: Use the fixed frozen client, harness and candidate SigningWorker above. Verify all six versions and placement settings before each arm. Do not deploy a different current working tree.
reproduction.placementApi: PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/seams-sdk-d1-console-staging/settings; multipart settings contains placement.region. Guard the current version and preserve all other settings.
reproduction.cleanupRequirement: Restore placement explicitly while latest settings version is deployed, then restore original versions. Verify placement separately from deployment version IDs.
